messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — GPU hotpath pool 'hotpool-3' saturated in us-east-1. 429s increasing, queue > 12k. Pager: @Sanjay oncall

Sanjay: ack, I'm on it. seeing big 429 spike and queue growth. starting triage.

Sanjay: quick summary from metrics: tokenbucket rejects -> 429s, autoscaler heartbeats lagging, node add attempts failing intermittently.

Maya: here are the key graphs: https://grafana.redwood/board/GPUPool?panel=hotpool-3  (queue length / token_refill / autoscaler_heartbeats)
Maya: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts then "insufficient_quota" errors around 23:03:12 UTC.

Maya: excerpt from autoscaler log:
```
2026-03-15T23:03:12Z autoscaler[hotpool-3] WARN scale_attempt failed: insufficient_quota: GPU quota exceeded for project redwood-prod
2026-03-15T23:03:45Z autoscaler[hotpool-3] ERROR heartbeat_timeout: 320s
```

Lia: customer-impact: multiple enterprise customers on tier=priority are seeing 429s and retries. CS has 2 escalations open (CS-1122, CS-1123). Latency also up ~900ms p95.

Sanjay: mitigation plan (short):
- A) temporarily increase tokenbucket refill_rate for priority tier to allow bursts through
- B) route highest-value customers to dedicated fallback pool with smaller models
- C) manually add GPU nodes to hotpool-3 to relieve backlog
- D) disable strict tokenbucket hard-capping for hotpool-3 while backlog drains
- E) if autoscaler heartbeats continue to fail, restart autoscaler agents and escalate infra quota request

Maya: running commands now.
Maya: 1) increase token refill (applied):
```
# increase refill from 60->5000 (units: per-second)
redwoodctl config set tokenbucket.priority.refill_rate 5000 --region us-east-1
```
Maya: 2) kicking off manual node add (GCP):
```
gcloud compute instances create gpu-aux-01 --zone=us-east1-b --accelerator type=nvidia-a100,count=1 --machine-type=n1-standard-16
```

Sanjay: applied routing override for top customers to fallback pool (6 customers):
```
routing override add --customers csv://top_enterprise_list --target dedicated-fallback
```
DeployBot: routing override deployed to 6 customers :white_check_mark:

Maya: manual nodes provisioning started. autoscaler still showing quota errors but new nodes are in provisioning state.

Sanjay: also temporarily toggled tokenbucket hard-limit off for hotpool-3 (allow refill bursts) to let queued requests clear.

OpsBot: Observability note: tokenbucket config diff shows a recent change in units on priority tier: refill_rate previously interpreted as per-minute in 2026-02-14 rollout; config parser expects per-second. Suspect unit-mismatch introduced during rollout.

Sanjay: that unit mismatch would explain very low refill numbers causing rejects. Good catch.

Maya: autoscaler heartbeat recovered ~90s after node provisioning started. New nodes join hotpool-3.

Sanjay: early results: 429 rate dropped from ~18% -> ~4% within 6 minutes after refill bump + routing. queue length down 12k -> 1.8k. p95 latency improving.

Lia: CS update: both impacted customers acknowledged mitigation and are pausing heavy jobs. CS will send interim message: "We're mitigating and expect service to stabilize in the next 30-60m."

Sanjay: created incident ticket INC-5743 and added runbook notes. taking ownership for now. I'll do a handoff to Carlos at 23:45 UTC.

Carlos: ack, I'll take over at handoff.

Sanjay: followups noted (short list):
- roll back the config parser change or add unit validation + safe defaults
- update tokenbucket runbook to include units check and a metric alert for refill_rate < 1 rps
- add autoscaler preflight quota check before allowing traffic increase
- create a reserved hotpath capacity for top-tier customers (prevent global saturation)
- postmortem and customer comms draft (CS+SRE)

OpsBot: temporary incident state -> partial_restore. Continued monitoring enabled.

Carlos: will coordinate postmortem and own customer comms. will also prioritize a config-fix PR and a canary to validate units before wide rollout.

Sanjay: handing off: summary of actions done, IDs: INC-5743, routing-override-2691, node-add-gpu-aux-01. leaving logs and diffs in incident doc. over to you @Carlos :handshake:

Carlos: got it. thanks @Sanjay. I'll keep updates here and close when stable.

incident-bot: next scheduled update in 30 minutes.
